observation.measurement_scope: FY2016-FY2018 cumulative OCF less maintenance-oriented capital expenditure, with working-capital change, closure-related permanent loss/disposal proceeds and opening/average operating capital explicitly bridged
observation.summary: The three audited annual reports disclose consolidated OCF, total cash paid to acquire long-term assets and balance-sheet accounts, but do not allocate total capex into maintenance versus expansion or provide a fully compatible closure-related permanent-loss/disposal and opening/average operating-capital bridge. Estimating a maintenance share or treating impairment as both cash capex and a second capital loss would violate the frozen contract. The continuous capital-return diagnostic therefore remains UNKNOWN and carries no binary verdict.
